moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will be held on August 16th at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, a week before the Premier League season kicks off.

angles.name: Cardiff hosts season opener
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff is set to host the FA Community Shield on August 16th! Who are you backing, Arsenal or Man City?

angles.name: Premier League curtain raiser
angles.copy: Just over two weeks until the Premier League season officially kicks off, but first: the Community Shield on August 16th! Arsenal v Man City – who's taking the first silverware?

angles.name: Man City vs Arsenal
angles.copy: The battle for the Community Shield is set for August 16th, as Arsenal face Manchester City. Will it be a sign of things to come this Premier League season?

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart incoming
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart Top 40 is typically updated on Fridays, meaning a fresh look at the nation's most popular tracks will be revealed tomorrow, July 31st.

angles.name: Chart update tomorrow
angles.copy: New music Friday means a brand new Official UK Singles Chart tomorrow! What's your prediction for the No.1 spot this week?

angles.name: Who will top the charts?
angles.copy: The race for the top of the UK Singles Chart is on! The new chart is revealed tomorrow. Any dark horses you think could sneak into the Top 10?

angles.name: Your No.1 prediction
angles.copy: Tomorrow, a new UK Singles Chart will be crowned! Tell us your ultimate number one prediction right now.

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset kicks off
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Camp Bestival Dorset begins today, July 30th, and runs until August 2nd, offering a mix of music, food, and activities at Lulworth Castle.

angles.name: Festival fun starts now
angles.copy: Camp Bestival Dorset is officially underway! Four days of family fun, music, and good vibes at Lulworth Castle. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Family festival vibes
angles.copy: Sun's out, wellies are on (maybe!) – Camp Bestival Dorset has arrived! Kicking off today for a weekend of brilliant family memories.

moments.title: Kendal Calling begins
moments.blurb: Kendal Calling, the award-winning festival in the Lake District, starts today, July 30th, and runs until August 2nd, bringing music and arts to Lowther Deer Park.

angles.name: Kendal Calling is here
angles.copy: The gates are open! Kendal Calling takes over the Lake District from today until Sunday. Who's got their tickets and is ready for the fields?

angles.name: Lake District festival
angles.copy: Kendal Calling is on! If you're heading to Lowther Deer Park this weekend for the music and mud, have an epic time!

moments.title: Cambridge Folk Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The renowned Cambridge Folk Festival runs from August 1st to 2nd, showcasing a diverse lineup of folk and roots artists at Cherry Hinton Hall Grounds.

angles.name: Folk Fest weekend
angles.copy: Cambridge Folk Festival starts this Saturday! Get ready for a weekend of incredible acoustic sets and roots music. Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Roots music in Cambridge
angles.copy: The legendary Cambridge Folk Festival is just around the corner, starting August 1st. Celebrating the best in folk and acoustic talent!

moments.title: The Roots Picnic UK debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its highly anticipated international debut in London on August 8th and 9th at Crystal Palace Bowl, blending music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Roots Picnic hits London
angles.copy: The legendary Roots Picnic is coming to London's Crystal Palace Bowl on August 8th-9th for its UK debut! Get ready for a huge weekend of music and culture.

angles.name: Hip Hop festival in UK
angles.copy: Big news for UK festival-goers! The Roots Picnic is bringing its world-class hip hop and R&B lineup to London next weekend. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Joe Elliott turns 67
moments.blurb: Joe Elliott, the iconic lead vocalist of British rock legends Def Leppard, celebrates his 67th birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Joe Elliott
angles.copy: Pour some sugar on him! Happy 67th birthday to the legendary Joe Elliott, frontman of Def Leppard, on August 1st!

angles.name: Def Leppard's voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to Def Leppard's incredible vocalist, Joe Elliott, this Saturday! What's your favourite Leppard track?

moments.title: James Hetfield turns 63
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, the formidable co-founder, frontman, and rhythm guitarist of Metallica, celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3rd.

angles.name: Happy Birthday James Hetfield
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 63rd birthday to the metal god himself, James Hetfield of Metallica, on August 3rd! What's your go-to Metallica anthem?

angles.name: Metallica frontman's bday
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield, the legendary voice and riff-master of Metallica, turns 63 this Monday. Celebrate with your favourite track!

moments.title: Yungblud turns 29
moments.blurb: Dominic Harrison, better known as the genre-bending rock and alternative pop artist Yungblud, celebrates his 29th birthday on August 5th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Yungblud
angles.copy: Big happy 29th birthday wishes to the one and only Yungblud on August 5th! What's your favourite track from the Doncaster rocker?

angles.name: Yungblud's 29th
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible energy and music of Yungblud as he turns 29 this Wednesday! Drop your favourite lyric below!

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson turns 68
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, the legendary lead singer of heavy metal icons Iron Maiden, celebrates his 68th birthday on August 7th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Bruce Dickinson
angles.copy: Scream for me, birthday boy! Happy 68th to the one and only Bruce Dickinson of Iron Maiden on August 7th! Up the Irons!

angles.name: Maiden's legendary voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Iron Maiden's incredible frontman, Bruce Dickinson, this Friday! What's your favourite Maiden classic?
